FCoE is a storage protocol, unrelated to EVPN host advertisement.

items.stem: A stateless server deployment lets a replacement blade assume the failed server's identity. Which construct enables this?

options.rationale: Correct: a service profile abstracts identity so it can move to new hardware.
A VSAN segments storage traffic; it does not carry server identity.
Root bridge election is unrelated to server identity portability.
A DHCP reservation maps an address, not full server identity/policy.

items.explanation: Correct: a service profile abstracts identity so it can move to new hardware.

Correct: VSANs isolate fabrics and fault domains.
